profile.headline: Software Developer - Leidos
profile.summary: Dedicated IT employee with two years of government contractor experience looking for new opportunities to grow professionally. I hold an active secret security clearance.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Supporting Navy-sponsored AEWTTR program by developing, maintaining, and enhancing mission-critical software for threat-emitting radar systems and associated support equipment
Design and enhance both user-facing and low-level software written in C++ that interfaces directly with radar hardware components, improving system reliability and performance
Conduct code reviews and maintain best practices for code quality and version control using Git and GitLab

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for analyzing reliability, maintainability, and availability metrics for equipment onboard US Navy ships.
Utilized multiple databases to pull ship equipment failure data to create a model of system readiness using reliability block diagrams and Markov state processes.
Evaluated RM&A metrics and scenarios to propose improvements to Navy logistics and maintenance procedures for program managers and stakeholders
positions.insights: Systems Engineering, Reliability, Availability, Maintainability, Safety (RAMS) and +2 skills

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Implement new features, improvements, and bug fixes in the C++ programming language to a NAVAIR sponsored aircraft simulation software suite running on Windows and Linux environments
Utilize QT C++ library to make changes to the project UI depending on client requirements.
Perform quality control on team members’ code to ensure functionality, reliability, and readability of legacy project code base
